narrative.overview: SportsWorld is a broadcast control room for a whole season: a deep navy ground holding dense, edge-lit panels that each read out one part of a single persistent Monte Carlo model. Condensed heavy numerals, cobalt hairlines, one electric blue accent, and the teams' own official colours wherever a team is the subject. Density is deliberate and every surface is dark; depth comes from luminous edges, not lifted cards. The only imagery is real ESPN team logos, and every number is real engine output.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground with fixed radial blue glows; cobalt-edged translucent panels with a gradient top-edge glow.
One accent, electric blue, as fill and as readable ink; gold only for trophies and title odds.
Barlow Condensed 700-800 for titles and headline figures, Barlow for UI, tabular numerals everywhere.
Team-colour header band and two-colour win-probability bars in official team colours.
Twelve-column grid stepping at 1360/1080/760px, with phone game cards.
Three motions only, all removed under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Hue Probability Rule
rules.body: Probabilities use one blue hue whose intensity rises with value (>=50% Signal Blue Ink bold, 10-50% ink bold, 0.5-10% ink-2, <0.5% ink-3). Never green, amber or red.

rules.name: The Reserved Signal Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean leverage, live state, signed change or model health only.

rules.name: The Official Colours Rule
rules.body: Teams appear only in official colours; near-black primaries fall back to the alternate; clashing bars switch the home side to its other official colour. Never invent a team colour.

rules.name: The Condensed Figure Rule
rules.body: A number that is the point of its container is set in Barlow Condensed 700 or heavier.

rules.name: The Cobalt Edge Rule
rules.body: Containers are defined by their cobalt edge and top glow, never by raised drop shadows or lighter fills.

dos: Do colour any probability with the one-hue intensity ramp.
Do put a team's official colour on its own band, bar segment and chart line, using the alternate when the primary is near-black.
Do label both ends of every win-probability bar and choose ink against the segment underneath.
Do build new containers as Panels: cobalt edge, top-edge glow, 12px corners, condensed 20px title with a line icon.
Do set headline figures in Barlow Condensed 700-800 with tabular numerals.
Do caption panels with where their numbers come from.
Do fall back to a monogram disc in the team's visible colour when a logo is missing.
donts: Don't use green, amber or red for anything but leverage, live state, signed deltas and model health.
Don't invent a colour for a team.
Don't ship photographs, illustrations or decorative rasters; ESPN logos are the only imagery.
Don't show figures the engine does not produce, even as placeholders.
Don't lift panels with large drop shadows or lighter fills.
Don't add motion beyond the bar ease, live pulse and score tick, and never without a reduced-motion opt-out.
